description:
Get a quote and create an order from it in one call, returning both as `quote` and
`order`. Takes the `get_quote` arguments, with `refund_address` required. Creating an
order screens its addresses, so use this only once the user wants to swap, and `get_quote`
to check a price.

affiliates.description:
Affiliate fees as comma-separated `<address>:<bps>` pairs, e.g. "0xabc...:50". Addresses
are EVM, except on a token swap to Tron, where a Tron address is also accepted.

amount.description: Amount to swap as an integer string in the source token's smallest unit

recipient.description: Address receiving the funds, encoded for the destination chain

refund_address.description: Refund address on the source chain

sender.description:
Address sending the funds, encoded for the source chain. On onramps it lets create-order
return a funded PSBT, which may spend the address's ordinals, inscriptions or runes as
plain sats: omit it for an address holding any.

slippage.description: Slippage tolerance in basis points (max 1000). Omit to let the gateway pick one per route.

name: quote_and_create
